articles.title: Former Rangers Player Urges Clubs and SFA to Take Steps for Youth Improvement
articles.description: Former Rangers man Alan Hutton warns that Scotland's talent pipeline is stalling, calling for a clear pathway into first teams to ensure the national side's future success and sustainability.

articles.title: Zalando increases quarterly revenue by 5 percent
articles.description: Berlin-based online fashion retailer Zalando SE also increased its revenue in the third quarter of the 2026 financial year. According to an interim report published on Tuesday, the company also made progress in its adjusted operating result.
